changes: Deer notice you and run off as a herd: sneak (crouch) or stand still to get closer, sprint and they spot you from farther away
Wolves keep their distance from you unless their pack is hungry
Hungry wolf packs travel toward the nearest deer herd, so you can come across a hunt
Deer and wolves pick idle behaviours by species (grazing, looking up, ear flicks, sitting, lying down); the poses aren't drawn yet
